Uber Stylized Water - surface opening prototype
Source: https://github.com/MatrixRex/Uber-Stylized-Water
Pinned commit: 1fdd16c6312611fef7fb248dee86cdd3fd456a1e
License: MIT, original LICENSE.txt and Cyan custom-lighting license retained.
Only the exported shader, two required HLSL includes, and three foam/normal/noise textures are imported.
No third-party editor tools, reflection scripts, demo scenes or pipeline settings are imported.

Local shader changes: renamed Reefkeeper/Uber Surface; opaque render queue, Blend One Zero, ZWrite On; custom inspector omitted.
Added a cheap view-angle and wave-slope color modulation to the exported color passes, without a reflection camera.
Surface foam, two-way normals, small Gerstner waves and specular highlights enabled on the project material.
Planar reflection, refraction, caustics, underwater layer, shoreline and intersection effects disabled.
Entry disables this surface renderer and restores the existing underwater system.
PICO performance and stereo behavior still need actual headset testing.

Full visual trial (2026-11-17, requested after the lightweight trial):
- Active scene now uses SurfaceWater_Full.mat / Reefkeeper/Uber Surface Full.
- Full exported upstream shader retained, only its shader name and unavailable custom inspector changed. Original transparent blend, queue and depth states restored.
- All seven shader feature keywords enabled: normals, waves, planar reflections, refraction, caustics, shoreline, underwater foam layer; surface and intersection foam also enabled.
- Original planar-reflection components imported. Local fixes: preserve configured layer masks; skip disabled water and release reflection resources; always restore render settings with finally; disable automatic/stereo rendering on the auxiliary camera; expose RenderForCamera for preview.
- Full reflection uses one monoscopic reflection texture, as upstream; XR stereo alignment is not validated and may need a per-eye implementation before shipping.
- Added Caustic 1 texture. Opening camera depth/color copies are enabled only above water and restored on dive.
- Existing opaque and lightweight assets remain available for comparison. Full grid is 40,401 vertices / 80,000 triangles, with half-metre spacing near the player.
- Full visual quality is the priority of this trial; PICO performance is not measured.
